+Title: NETGUARD-drop-hold: a full read that drops a NAT-PMP answer stores the new gateway with no external address and no hold (release; from #1550 Potency B2)

+### Checked (no finding)
+- **Privileges.** rtnetlink allows NONROOT_RECV. The unit already has AF_NETLINK and an empty CapabilityBoundingSet.
+- **Spoofing.** A spoofed sender needs CAP_NET_ADMIN.
+- **Parser.** It is bounds-safe: 800k fuzz executions with no panic and at most one gateway read per datagram.
+- **Storms.** An IPv4 message for another host costs one /proc/net/route read. IPv6 messages are skipped first.
+- **Failure.** If the subscription fails, the existing poll-only fallback applies.
+- **Double change.** No new way for an old router's address to be allowed: every key is the same around its request, and the moved path uses the quick-read merge only when gen is unchanged, then re-kicks.
+- **Holder.** It can now hold after `ErrGatewayMoved` (fail closed; in the PR body).
+- **Hold bound.** One read is at most 2×3 s, under 7 s. A double move plus the re-read can pass it and refuse (fail closed; documented).
